verdicts.reason: A mixes alignments: the logo is centred, the NEW VIDEO badge floats off-centre to the right, and the headline is flush left and almost touches the right edge, while the shoe and caption are centred again. It also leaves a lot of empty space at the top and bottom. B puts every element on one consistent left edge, which reads as more deliberate, but its spacing is uneven: there are big dead gaps between the badge and the headline and between the shoe and the caption, the headline is also tight to the right edge, and the logo is small and pushed into the corner.
